Frequently asked questions

Do you offer seasonal contracts?

Yes. A seasonal contract gives you priority service after every storm. We also offer per-storm service.

Do you remove snow from roofs?

Yes. We remove heavy snow from roofs and gutters to help prevent ice dams and leaks.

When do you come after a storm?

Contract clients are served first, as soon as it is safe to work. We can also come during long storms to keep entrances open.

Service area: about 25 miles around Lowell, MA

We serve homes and businesses in Lowell, Dracut, Chelmsford, Tewksbury, Billerica, Westford, Tyngsborough, Lawrence, Methuen, Andover, North Andover, Haverhill, Wilmington, Burlington, Woburn, Bedford, Acton, Littleton in Massachusetts, plus Nashua, Hudson, Salem, Pelham, Windham, Londonderry, Derry, Merrimack in southern New Hampshire.
